items.title: Bind the track to Lattice Stories and committed truth sources
items.context: Use docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-authority-live-integration.md and docs/requirements/NAV.md as the committed source of truth. Create child Stories through Lattice commands only; no direct story JSON edits.

items.title: Run Stage A readiness preflight and endpoint status discovery
items.context: Record lattice check plus authority receipt/runner/enforce/live-python smoke evidence and fill the server endpoint status table before dependent authority DONE work.

items.title: Decompose 15-agent bounded parallel execution lanes
items.context: Codex CLI coordinates review/confirmation; Claude CLI and Gemini CLI execute only non-overlapping Stories. Default width is 6+1; 13-15 is a temporary burst ceiling under documented conditions.

items.title: Start the deterministic first implementation slice
items.context: Begin with Authority job schema, signed job envelope, provider.fake, executor state machine skeleton, and evidence path that do not depend on missing server receipt minting.

items.title: Gate final track DONE through multi-host verification and docs sync
items.context: Final completion requires fresh validation, global lattice smoke, public docs/help sync, and independent host verdicts according to the requirements document.
